svg.title: A gravitational-wave chirp
svg.desc: Newtonian inspiral and Kerr ringdown for a 36+29 solar mass pair.

cc:Work.dc:creator: Nan, hongdam.net
cc:Work.dc:description: computed by tools/figures.py from the equation it shows

svg.text: A chirp: 36 + 29 solar masses, the last third of a second
chirp mass 28.1 M☉ — the one number the shape of the chirp gives away; the pitch rises as the pair spiral in, then rings down at 278 Hz
strain h(t), in units of its peak; inspiral by formula to about merger, then a damped ring at the final hole's tone
frequency, 20 Hz → 149 Hz at merger, roughly
